metadata.title: Branched real projective structures on surfaces and geometrisation of representations
metadata.abstract: We introduce and study branched real projective structures on compact surfaces. Our main result shows that every representation of the fundamental group of a compact surface into $PSL(3,\mathbb R)$ arises as the holonomy representation of a branched real projective structure, regardless of whether the surface is orientable. We also consider the realisation problem with prescribed branching data, relating the branching degree to the second Stiefel--Whitney class of the representation. The results obtained in this direction suggest several interesting avenues for future research.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 引入紧曲面的分支实射影结构，证明到 PSL(3,R) 的每个基本群表示均可作为其 holonomy，包括非定向曲面。
analysis.breakthrough: 通过允许分支扩大表示的几何实现范围，并联系分支次数与拓扑特征类。
analysis.limitations: 无指定分支的存在定理，不等于任意预定分支数据均可实现；后者只是进一步研究方向。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 表示几何与曲面结构联系强，构造方法有较高几何价值。
